name: Roflgator
title: Wingman Robot
species: Alligator (also portrays a robot, an android, and other personas)
aliases: Rob, Robert, Coach, Boss, Ron, Ronald von Awfulgator
description: Roflgator is a full-time Twitch streamer known for improvised roleplay in [VRChat](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/VRChat), portraying a mischievous alligator persona who runs his own bar community, [The Golden Gator](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/The_Golden_Gator). Before streaming full-time starting in 2018, he worked in competitive esports, coaching League of Legends and Overwatch teams including Fnatic. He is known for wing-manning and stirring up lighthearted RP drama, has cycled through many alternate avatars and personas over the years, and regularly hosts community game shows and dating-style events with guest streamers.
